ShortDescription.Value: Generate additional native road-traffic requests for disposable-city stress testing.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA / EXPERIMENTAL — use a test city.
WHAT IT DOES Amplifies already-approved random road departures at 2x, 5x, 10x or 25x. Native CS2 spawning, vehicle selection and routing handle each departure. It does not multiply every commuter or service trip.
HOW TO USE Open TSL, choose a preset, then Start Test. Switch presets while running or Stop Extra Departures to return to vanilla generation. Options controls ramp speed and the extra departures per batch cap.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Through-traffic follows native approved routes; roads outside those routes can remain quiet. The cap can limit effective pressure and the panel reports this. Extra Departures Queued counts approved spawning entries; Road Vehicles counts current road vehicle entities, not confirmed TSL-created cars. A higher departure rate is not a guaranteed total vehicle-count multiplier. Existing cars finish normally after stopping. Current amplification has build/offline checks; in-game density and compatibility validation remains pending.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.5.7-beta.1 — Approved departure amplification
Replace cloned random-traffic requests rejected by native per-spawner ownership validation with bounded amplification of approved ServiceDispatch entries immediately before native spawning. Match native spawn cadence and retain target/path checks. Report road vehicles, ready routes and cap pressure; allow live preset switching.
Debug/Release/UI and offline regression checks are recorded in docs/traffic-stress-qa-2026-10-14.md. In-game validation remains pending.
